mapper.sql: a.owner_id,a.id,a.session_id,a.question_id,a.version_number,q.latest_answer_id,q.answer_count, h.version_number AS latest_number,q.title,s.mode,s.status AS session_status, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.config_json,'$.feedbackTiming')) AS feedback_timing, q.question_kind,a.answer_condition,a.assistance_event_sequence,a.exposure_json,a.created_at, JSON_OBJECT('technology',JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.content.technology'), 'scenario',JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.content.scenario'), 'conditions',JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.content.conditions')) AS question_context_json, (JSON_TYPE(s.config_json)='OBJECT' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.config_json,'$.feedbackTiming'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(q.snapshot_json)='OBJECT' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.content'))='OBJECT') AS metadata_valid

JOIN training_question q ON q.owner_id=a.owner_id AND q.session_id=a.session_id AND q.id=a.question_id JOIN training_session s ON s.owner_id=a.owner_id AND s.id=a.session_id LEFT JOIN training_answer h ON h.owner_id=a.owner_id AND h.session_id=a.session_id AND h.question_id=a.question_id AND h.id=q.latest_answer_id

JSON_OBJECT('text',JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,'$.text'), 'nodeLabels',COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,'$.diagram.nodes[*].label'),JSON_ARRAY()), 'nodeDescriptions',COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,'$.diagram.nodes[*].description'),JSON_ARRAY()), 'edgeLabels',COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,'$.diagram.edges[*].label'),JSON_ARRAY())) AS texts_json, (JSON_TYPE(a.content_json)='OBJECT' AND JSON_LENGTH(a.content_json)=2 AND OCTET_LENGTH(a.content_json)<=196608 AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,'$.text'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,'$.diagram'))='OBJECT' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,'$.diagram.nodes'))='ARRAY' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,'$.diagram.edges'))='ARRAY' AND JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,'$.diagram.nodes'))<=80 AND JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,'$.diagram.edges'))<=160 AND JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,'$.diagram.nodes'))=COALESCE(JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,'$.diagram.nodes[*].label')),0) AND JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,'$.diagram.nodes'))=COALESCE(JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,'$.diagram.nodes[*].description')),0) AND JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,'$.diagram.edges'))=COALESCE(JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,'$.diagram.edges[*].label')),0)) AS body_valid
mapper.select: SELECT , FROM training_answer a WHERE a.owner_id=#{owner} AND s.status IN ('RUNNING','PAUSED','ENDED') AND a.id < #{afterId} AND ( JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,'$.text')) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM JSON_TABLE(a.content_json,'$.diagram.nodes[*]' COLUMNS (node_label VARCHAR(200) PATH '$.label' NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR, node_description VARCHAR(5000) PATH '$.description' NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR)) node_text WHERE CONVERT(node_text.node_label USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR CONVERT(node_text.node_description USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM JSON_TABLE(a.content_json,'$.diagram.edges[*]' COLUMNS (edge_label VARCHAR(200) PATH '$.label' NULL ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR)) edge_text WHERE CONVERT(edge_text.edge_label USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!') ) ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.sql: f.owner_id,f.id,v.revision,f.revision AS current_revision,fh.revision AS actual_head_revision, f.session_id,f.question_id,f.answer_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.kind')) AS kind, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.authorLabel')) AS author_label, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.dimension')) AS dimension, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.coverage')) AS coverage, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.observation')) AS observation, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.condition')) AS `condition`, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.basis')) AS basis, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.limitation')) AS limitation, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.suggestion')) AS suggestion, d.id AS decision_id,d.revision AS decision_revision,d.choice AS decision_choice, d.reason AS decision_reason,d.created_at AS decision_created_at, (JSON_TYPE(v.content_json)='OBJECT' AND JSON_LENGTH(v.content_json)=10 AND OCTET_LENGTH(v.content_json)<=131072 AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.kind'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.authorLabel'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.dimension'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.coverage'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.observation'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.condition'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.basis'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.limitation'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.suggestion'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.citations'))='ARRAY' AND JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.citations'))<=6) AS metadata_valid

LEFT JOIN review_feedback_revision fh ON fh.owner_id=f.owner_id AND fh.feedback_id=f.id AND fh.revision=f.revision LEFT JOIN review_feedback_decision d ON d.owner_id=v.owner_id AND d.feedback_id=v.feedback_id AND d.feedback_revision=v.revision AND d.revision=(SELECT MAX(x.revision) FROM review_feedback_decision x WHERE x.owner_id=v.owner_id AND x.feedback_id=v.feedback_id AND x.feedback_revision=v.revision)
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM review_feedback f JOIN training_answer a ON a.owner_id=f.owner_id AND a.session_id=f.session_id AND a.question_id=f.question_id AND a.id=f.answer_id JOIN training_question q ON q.owner_id=a.owner_id AND q.session_id=a.session_id AND q.id=a.question_id JOIN training_session s ON s.owner_id=a.owner_id AND s.id=a.session_id JOIN ai_evaluation_access e ON e.owner_id=a.owner_id AND e.session_id=a.session_id AND e.question_id=a.question_id AND e.answer_id=a.id AND e.early_feedback IN (0,1) AND e.granted_at BETWEEN '1000-01-01 00:00:00.000000' AND '9999-12-31 23:59:59.999999' JOIN review_feedback_revision v ON v.owner_id=f.owner_id AND v.feedback_id=f.id AND v.revision=f.revision
WHERE f.owner_id=#{owner} AND s.status IN ('RUNNING','PAUSED','ENDED') AND a.version_number BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND ((s.mode='LEARNING' AND a.answer_condition='LEARNING') OR (s.mode IN ('FOCUSED','MOCK') AND a.answer_condition IN ('BEFORE_ASSISTANCE','ASSISTED'))) AND a.assistance_event_sequence BETWEEN 0 AND 2000 AND (a.answer_condition<>'ASSISTED' OR a.assistance_event_sequence>0) AND (a.answer_condition<>'BEFORE_ASSISTANCE' OR a.assistance_event_sequence=0) AND JSON_TYPE(s.config_json)='OBJECT' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.config_json,'$.feedbackTiming'))='STRING' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.config_json,'$.feedbackTiming')) IN ('AFTER_ANSWER','AFTER_SESSION') AND (s.status='ENDED' OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.config_json,'$.feedbackTiming'))='AFTER_ANSWER' OR e.early_feedback=1) AND f.id < #{afterId} AND ( JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.observation')) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.condition')) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.basis')) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.limitation')) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.suggestion')) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' ) ORDER BY f.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.sql: r.owner_id,r.id,v.id AS version_id,v.version_number,r.revision AS source_revision, r.current_version_id,r.version_number AS head_version_number,h.version_number AS actual_head_version_number, r.status,v.title,v.baseline_kind,v.content_json
LEFT JOIN review_recollection_version h ON h.owner_id=r.owner_id AND h.recollection_id=r.id AND h.id=r.current_version_id
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM review_recollection r JOIN review_recollection_version v ON v.owner_id=r.owner_id AND v.recollection_id=r.id AND v.id=r.current_version_id
WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.status=#{status} AND r.id < #{afterId} AND ( JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.title')) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.question')) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.conditions')) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.answerFragment')) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.feedback')) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.uncertainty')) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.gap')) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' ) ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
